entities.summary: Pagan Empire, a political institution in Myanmar during Pagan Empire (1210–1297). Grew from Over 10,000 Buddhist temples, monasteries, and pagodas built on the Bagan plain and Construction of Ananda Temple — masterpiece of Mon-Burman Buddhist architecture. Led to the emergence of Mongol forces invade and the Pagan Empire collapses and Wareru founds the Mon kingdom of Hanthawaddy (Pegu).
